background.value: white, uniform lighting throughout, no shadows

head_height.value: face covers 70-80% of photo height from chin to forehead, face centered

expression_restriction.value: neutral expression, mouth closed, no smiling, eyes open and clearly visible, direct gaze at camera

glasses_policy.value: permitted if eyes remain clearly visible; no sunglasses or tinted lenses; heavy frames that cover eye areas prohibited; avoid flash reflections on lenses

headwear_policy.value: not permitted except for religious reasons with clear justification; face contours from chin to forehead and both sides of face must be clearly visible

face_visibility.value: full face visible, not in profile, eyes open and clearly visible, no flash reflections, person must appear alone

size.evidence: The cited source (Italian Embassy Vienna ICAO norms page) explicitly states 'Grandezza: 35x45 mm' for Italian passport photos. Independent confirmation from the Italian Consulate General in Houston ICAO guidelines page also states 'Size: 35x45 mm'. Multiple third-party sources (passlens.com, passport-photo.online, visapicpro.com) consistently confirm 35x45mm for Italian passport photos. Italy follows the ICAO standard.
